name: txn-step-expect-version
$comment: OCC version semantics, derived from server code: ddl.rs creates the column as `"version" bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1` (so the seeded insert is _version 1) and apply_update runs `SET "version" = "version" + 1` (so the patch bumps it to 2). do_expect_version SELECTs the row's current version on the OPEN sqlx transaction, so it observes the bump from step 1 within the same txn; matching passes and both step results are null. A mismatch would be PRECONDITION_FAILED, not probed here.
